settings.title: Crochet
settings.text: The body is crocheted by hand, one stitch at a time: about 840 stitches and two hours of work.

settings.title: Assembly
settings.text: Head, arms and cloth are joined and sewn firm. That takes another hour and a half.

settings.title: Embroidery
settings.text: If you asked for a name, it is embroidered by hand.

settings.title: Check and gift box
settings.text: Each doll is checked, then wrapped in its gift box with its adoption certificate.

settings.maker_text: She crochets each doll herself, at a table by the window.
